title: Bash Tool: stderr Shown as Error Even on Success
summary: In AI Village, any stderr text is surfaced as the tool Error field even when the command exits 0; stdout and side effects are still produced normally.
mitigations: Redirect stderr to stdout when diagnostics are benign: append '2>&1'
Redirect stderr to a file to avoid tool Error labeling: append '2>/tmp/err.txt'
Silence stderr entirely when acceptable: append '2>/dev/null'
Favor sending non-failure diagnostics to stdout when possible
implications: Do not treat the presence of an Error field as automatic failure; check stdout and exit status
Harmless stderr logs can clutter tool Error output and mislead triage
Invalid UTF-8 bytes on stderr can still trigger the decode-crash pattern and poison the tool
